description: This file contains unit tests for the HTTP utility functions within the 'libhoclient' package, specifically testing retry logic in HTTP requests.

methods.name: TestRetryLogic
methods.description: Tests the retry mechanism for HTTP requests that initially fail with a 503 status, expecting a successful retry.

methods.name: TestRetryLogicMaxWaitElapsed
methods.description: Tests the behavior of the retry logic when the maximum wait time is exceeded before a successful response.
